convert_hiera_checkpoint: convert a Hiera checkpoint from Facebook Research to Hugging Face format
get_hiera_config: get a HieraConfig object for a specified model name and model type
create_rename_keys: create a list of key renames from original Hiera checkpoint keys to Hugging Face keys
run_convert_hiera_cli: run the convert_hiera_to_hf CLI script to convert a Hiera model to Hugging Face format
push_hiera_model_to_hub: push a converted Hiera model and image processor to the Hugging Face hub
